recurrence-editor.$description: RecurrenceEditor: the choices of how something repeats on a grid of two columns (the kit's fields), the weekday buttons and the line that says it in words. The gaps of the grid are plain tokens; the weekday buttons are a place (the kit's button); every other piece is a unit.

day-button.$description: A weekday button: its variant and size, its shape (corners, the least width, the room on its sides) and how a day that is on looks, for a solid and an outline button.

editor.$description: The editor as a whole: a frame or a fill around its choices, when a language draws one.

days-label.$description: The caption over the weekday buttons, as a field's label.

days.$description: The row of weekday buttons: the room between them, or one frame around them all when a language joins them.

summary.$description: The line that says how it repeats.
